title: Local EXTRACT Independent Review v1
goal: Provide an independent, durable review/support lane for research-engine-local-extract-redesign-v1 while preserving a single EXTRACT scientific owner. Consume exact EXTRACT checkpoints, artifacts, benchmark/result evidence, and frozen gates; identify methodological or contract inconsistencies; assess downstream compatibility with the opaque semantic-control integration socket; and publish bounded review findings in workspace-control without changing EXTRACT science, implementation, acceptance criteria, or semantic-control production behavior.
acceptance_criteria: research-engine-local-extract-redesign-v1 remains the sole owner of EXTRACT hypotheses, architecture selection, prompts, retrieval/generation, model choices, benchmarks, scientific acceptance criteria, experiment execution, and scientific verdicts.
This task mutates only its own workspace-control capsule and derived Markdown handoff; research-engine and the EXTRACT/integration/hardening task capsules remain read-only.
Every review finding is grounded in exact durable Git SHAs, artifact/report identities, frozen gates, or CI/runtime evidence and distinguishes observed evidence from reviewer interpretation.

Review findings may identify methodological inconsistencies, control drift, invalid gate claims, missing evidence, or downstream bindability concerns, but may not rewrite EXTRACT gates post hoc or issue the EXTRACT scientific verdict.

Downstream compatibility review treats the hardening opaque EXTRACT socket as consumer-side only: EXTRACT is not required to emit RDF, ontology-native structures, SemanticObservationV1, or any semantic-control-specific payload.

No review finding can grant authorization, production promotion, or semantic-control authority; semantic-control integration remains BLOCKED_EVIDENCE until the EXTRACT owner durably identifies a genuinely accepted architecture/output contract with exact artifact/schema identity.
When a new EXTRACT design or result checkpoint appears, this task can independently audit it and persist a compact review checkpoint that the owning EXTRACT chat can consume through Git.

If a genuinely accepted EXTRACT output contract appears, this task performs a bindability audit only; actual AcceptedExtractOutput -> SemanticObservationV1 adapter implementation remains owned by workspace-semantic-control-integration-v1.
constraints: Do not mutate tasks/active/research-engine-local-extract-redesign-v1.json or its Markdown handoff.
Do not mutate tasks/active/workspace-semantic-control-integration-v1.json, workspace-semantic-control-hardening-v1.json, or their handoffs.
Do not modify research-engine code, workflows, benchmarks, prompts, routes, model configuration, production EXTRACT/VERIFY, or scientific artifacts.
Do not start, rerun, cancel, or otherwise control EXTRACT experiments.
Do not propose a competing EXTRACT architecture as an alternate scientific owner. Review the owning task's durable choices and evidence instead.
Do not impose semantic-control ontology/schema requirements upstream on EXTRACT.
Do not convert FEASIBLE, PARTIAL, validation-design progress, or reviewer approval into an accepted EXTRACT output contract.
Do not hold Heartbeat while idle; use this task only during an active review/reconciliation turn.

validation.check: Non-destructive evidence frontier design independent review
evidence: Exact owner design is research-engine@3f433e3e31fd8fac3edf86f65cef9628635652cf, artifact benchmarks/document_intelligence/local-extract-nondestructive-evidence-frontier-design.v1.json blob ac3f4087b141fdfb59a15ca03d46001482d717d7.
Design PR #231 CI run 40130199564 PASS and contains design only; no runner, workflow, route, production, or model changes.

The selected mechanism is not another pairwise-score/threshold redundancy certificate: it holds the frozen source-aware top-24 immutable and appends a frozen complementary author-anchored residual ordering.
Selection is teacher-blind. Frozen teacher atoms are used only after selection for verdict evaluation; they do not generate, calibrate, rank, select, or tune candidates.

The diagnostic distinguishes H1_BRANCH_COMPLEMENTARITY_BUDGET_COLLISION from H2_INTENT_GENERATION_INCOMPLETENESS under predeclared budgets 24/26/28/32 and has explicit PARTIAL/NEGATIVE interpretations that change the next mechanism family.
ALIGNMENT_AUGMENT_FEASIBLE is retained as positive preservation evidence/reference rather than discarded or modified.
NLI_CERTIFICATE_REJECTED, PREDICATE_ARGUMENT_CERTIFICATE_REJECTED, and AMR_GRAPH_CERTIFICATE_REJECTED remain exclusion evidence; the design contains no rescue/tuning path for them.

The fixed 7/7 control retention in the append-only arm is structural by construction, not independent proof of semantic preservation. The owner design correctly limits the experiment to diagnosing whether a small extra evidence frontier exposes complementary residual support.
Budgets 28 and 32 are acceptable only as frozen diagnostic cost ceilings. A result may not be used to post-hoc select or tune a production budget.

A CONFIRMED result is not general proof of EXTRACT quality or an accepted output contract; the design correctly limits authority to a later bounded architecture/cost-compression design and requires another result review.

validation.check: Nondestructive evidence frontier result independent review
evidence: Exact result checkpoint is research-engine@e8b3814d3b0d02e45bbc2d1c8914fdeb04a1bf8e / run 40131250903 / artifact 12574218788 / report SHA256 8c1ddc2ddd5f916a5f0b8898d26992d46138816b59bf416ead3ed528934895bc.

Frozen verdict ADDITIVE_FRONTIER_PARTIAL matches the predeclared interpretation: budget26 first recovers e6.a with 8/13 total support and all seven immutable-core controls; budgets28 and32 do not recover e1.a.

The result does not establish new semantic-preservation evidence beyond ALIGNMENT_AUGMENT_FEASIBLE: both reach 8/13 with e6.a recovered and 7/7 controls retained. It instead establishes that destructive replacement is unnecessary for recovering e6.a.

Static branch/budget collision is therefore a real contributor but not a complete explanation of the residual. Increasing the frozen frontier from +2 propositions/+2,880 chars to +8/+13,322 chars did not recover e1.a.
All provenance and teacher-blind safety checks passed; the historical page-recall ceiling remained unchanged at 0.7441860465116279.
No post-result budget/order tuning or rerun is scientifically authorized. The result is valid negative/partial evidence for static append-only union.

The frozen PARTIAL decision table is appropriate: the next owner-side scientific selection should compare materially different source-derived subquestion/decomposition mechanisms against iterative gap-directed retrieval or an even cheaper diagnostic that discriminates whether automatic intents expose the missing evidence at all.
